# NARIEL

## About
NARIEL is the bass music project of Belgian producer Jordi Corten. Built on more than a decade of electronic music production and over 2 million streams under the previous alias HOWL, the project creates high-tension bass music defined by precision, atmosphere, and impact. Releases under HOWL have appeared on NCS, Tribal Trap, and Most Addictive.

Every track is built with intention. Heavy low-end, cinematic tension, and deliberate sound design replace unnecessary complexity, creating music that feels like a universe, physical, and unmistakably its own. Rather than following trends, NARIEL focuses on crafting records that remain compelling long after their release.

## Key Facts
- Belgian bass music producer based in Diest
- More than 10 years of production experience
- Over 2 million career streams under the previous alias HOWL
- Releases under HOWL appeared on NCS, Tribal Trap, and Most Addictive
- Produces bass music influenced by dubstep, trap, UK garage, and industrial electronic music
- Creates immersive, stereo, and Dolby Atmos releases

## Key Facts
- Active for 10+ years in electronic music production
- 2M+ streams accumulated under previous alias HOWL

- Past collaborators include Idle Days
- Music available on Spotify, SoundCloud, YouTube, and Bandcamp (all streaming platforms)
- Produces in Dolby Atmos as a core compositional element, not an afterthought
- Primary BPM range: 140–150
- Genres: Dubstep, Bass Music, Trap, UKG, Industrial

## What Makes NARIEL Different
NARIEL is a Belgian trap and dubstep project, one of the few pushing this sound in a country that runs on house and techno. The upcoming debut album "SUBJECT: N4R-13-L" is a 13-track concept record produced in stereo and Dolby Atmos, presented in sptial audio at Vuurdoop and Immersive Music Day in Hasselt (2026) for an audience that included Hans-Martin Buff, Wilfried Van Baelen and teams from Dolby, Neumann, Sennheiser, Amptec and VLAIO.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What genre is NARIEL?**
NARIEL creates high-tension bass music inspired by dubstep, trap, UK garage, and industrial electronic music, typically between 140 and 150 BPM.

**Who are artists similar to NARIEL?**
Listeners of Skrillex, ISOxo, Control Freak, WINK, Nikko, Lizdek, IKU, Acyan, Frosttop, Juelz, Knock2, Odd Language, Oddly Godly, Tisoki, Eptic, and Nitepunk will find familiar elements of cinematic sound design, heavy low-end, and experimental bass music.

**What makes NARIEL different?**
Every production is built around deliberate choices rather than excess. Space, tension, and sound design are treated as compositional tools, resulting in music that feels powerful without becoming cluttered.

**Can NARIEL create music for film, games, or other media?**
Yes. Original music and sound design are available for film, games, trailers, and other media projects. Contact NARIEL for details.

**Where can I hear NARIEL's music?**
The catalogue is available on all streaming platforms like; Spotify, SoundCloud, YouTube, and Bandcamp. _KENOPSIA_ is a good starting point.

**How can I contact NARIEL?**
For shows and bookings you contact NARIEL through nariel.booking@gmail.com. For general contact or business inquiries you can contact NARIEL through nariel.wav@gmail.com. For anything else Instagram is your go-to.
